'''Sith Emperor''', or '''Emperor of the Sith''', was the [[King/Legends|sovereign ruler]] of the [[Sith Empire (disambiguation)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Legacy 16" /> At least three [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] ruled as Sith Emperor: [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]],<ref name="Revan" /> [[Darth Vowrawn]],<ref name="Traitor">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|A Traitor Among the Chiss}}</ref> and [[Darth Krayt]],<ref name="Legacy 16" /> while [[Darth Acina]] ruled as '''Sith Empress'''.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref> After what many believed to be the [[Dromund Kaas operation|death]] of Vitiate, [[Darth Malgus]] declared a "[[New Empire]]" and claimed the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] throne.<ref name="False Emperor" />
